verdict.rationale: Bruno supports bulk execution: the CLI runs entire collections in one command, and runs can be automated with data-driven testing. Its plain-text, filesystem-stored collections can be generated or edited in bulk by external AI agents such as Cursor or Codex, for example creating requests, tests and docs for each endpoint of a backend. However, bulk editing or management of many items is only implied through file access and outside tools, not offered as a native capability. Missing for 10: native bulk edit/update/delete across multiple requests or collections, documented batch-management commands in the CLI or AI features, independent hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
